title.rendered: Do ntopng Professional and Enterprise licenses need to be activated?

content.rendered: Yes. Installing a license key is only the first step. In order to unlock all features and guarantee full support and updates, the license must also be activated. In most cases this happens automatically the very first time ntopng starts with a Professional or Enterprise license installed. No action is required on your part. In fact, if the machine running ntopng has Internet access, ntopng contacts ntop’s activation servers automatically.
